notes: FAQ: 'Songmont is a Chinese original leather goods brand rooted in Eastern minimalist design aesthetics' (https://songmontofficial.com/pages/faqs). Store meta lists Wan Chai, HK and USD (https://songmontofficial.com/meta.json). Stores listed in Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Qingdao (https://songmontofficial.com/pages/our-locations).
